en-US.longDescription: Start, stop, and monitor your local dev servers from one dashboard. LocalDock manages the full process tree for every project, shows live console output, CPU/RAM/uptime, and can group related projects into a stack with one-click start-all/stop-all. It also runs a local MCP server so AI coding assistants can start, stop, and inspect dev servers directly.
en-US.name: LocalDock
